_comment: Mutations that put the FORK's screener/symbol-feed WebSocket
configuration back the way the fork had it.
This repo is a FORK of DepthSight-Pro/DepthSight and had lost the env
overrides on MAIN_APP_WS_URL and SYMBOL_SOURCE_MODE, had INVERTED the
MAIN_APP_WS_ENABLED default to 'true', and hardcoded the UPSTREAM's own
reserved hostname (screener.depthsight.pro) as the URL. That URL is not
this fork's deployment, it answers HTTP 525, and NOTHING in this fork
produces the 'active_pairs_update' message the bot's screener client
expects -- so the feed can never work here, and a DYNAMIC-mode strategy
started against it reports 'running' and silently never trades.
F1/F2/F3 put those three regressions back.
F4/F5/F12 break the shared rules in bot_module/screener_feed.py.
F6/F7/F8 remove one of the three doors that must refuse a DYNAMIC
strategy in the UNSAFE PAIRING (the consumer, the bot's Redis command
channel, and the HTTP route).
F9/F10/F11/F13 are the FALSE-POSITIVE mutations: they make the guard
refuse deployments that WOULD have worked, or stop it refusing the ones
that would not. Both directions must be caught.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/fork_screener_ws_config.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: F1: the fork ships the UPSTREAM's screener URL as its hardcoded default again (the fork regression)
mutations.replace: MAIN_APP_WS_URL = "wss://screener.depthsight.pro/ws/bot/"  # MUTANT: the upstream's reserved hostname

mutations.label: F2: the MAIN_APP_WS_ENABLED default is inverted back to 'true' (the 525 reconnect storm)
F3: the SYMBOL_SOURCE_MODE env override is removed again
F4: the shared rules stop recognising the UPSTREAM's host
mutations.replace: if False:  # MUTANT: the upstream's host is accepted

mutations.label: F5: a URL that is not a WebSocket is accepted
mutations.replace: if False:  # MUTANT: a non-WebSocket URL is accepted

mutations.label: F6: the consumer never refuses to start against a broken feed
mutations.replace: if False:  # MUTANT: the consumer never refuses

mutations.label: F7: the bot's Redis command channel never refuses a DYNAMIC strategy
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: the Redis door never refuses
            _dynamic_problem = screener_feed_misconfigured(

mutations.label: F8: the HTTP route never refuses a DYNAMIC strategy
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: the HTTP door never refuses
        _dynamic_problem = _screener_feed_misconfigured(

mutations.label: F9: FALSE POSITIVE - the upstream check becomes a SUFFIX match, so the owner's own host is refused
F10: FALSE POSITIVE - the upstream check becomes a SUBSTRING match, so the owner's own host is refused
mutations.replace: return "depthsight.pro" in ws_url_host(url)  # MUTANT: substring match

mutations.label: F11: FALSE POSITIVE - the SAFE pairing (feed off, URL empty) is treated as misconfigured
mutations.replace: if False:  # MUTANT: the safe pairing is treated as wrong

mutations.label: F12: FALSE POSITIVE - the refusal no longer points at THIS fork's own domain
mutations.replace: FORK_OWN_DOMAIN = "screener.example.invalid"  # MUTANT: no longer this fork

mutations.label: F13: the UNSAFE PAIRING (feed on, URL missing) is no longer refused
mutations.replace: return None  # MUTANT: the unsafe pairing is not refused

mutations.label: F14: the upstream pointer is no longer caught by the guard's own predicate
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: the upstream pointer is not caught here
        return _upstream_url_message(text, ws_url_host(text))
